# ================================================================
#  Burden of Infrastructure - Household water need
#
#  A new pop need adds cleanly (keyed database), but NOTHING
#  consumes it until it is listed in a wealth package of
#  common/buy_packages/00_buy_packages.txt. That file has one block
#  per wealth level, so the household demand lives in the OPTIONAL
#  module tools/water-prototype/ (generated by
#  tools/Build-WaterPrototype.ps1), not in the base mod. Without the
#  module, water has no buyers and the Waterworks simply sit idle.
#
#  Modelled on popneed_services: one entry, the local good itself.
# ================================================================

popneed_boi_water = {
	default = water

	entry = {
		goods = water
	}
}
